title: Language of the tableau family
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input and output alphabets, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and let $C,d$ be natural numbers. If $M$ decides $L$ within time $C(n+1)^d$ on inputs of length $n$, then the language accepted by the circuit family whose $n$th circuit is the configuration-tableau circuit for $M$ with time bound $(C+1)(n+1)^d$ is exactly $L$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ over Boolean symbols
